description: Calculates the AI at Work cost for a given number of seats (1-500), with optional co-branding. It flags when a higher tier is cheaper in total and shows the Executive Suite and Rollout Pack alternatives. It does not take an order. To check readiness, use assess_ai_readiness.

coBranding.description: Optional. True to include the company co-branding fee (free at higher seat counts). Defaults to false.

seats.description: Number of seats to quote, as a whole number.

name: get_seat_quote
title: Seat Quote
